pause_at_checkpoints.description: 明确需要科研反馈时，在segment_chunks个分段后暂停；默认false，与权限审批分开。

worker_rounds.description: 一个受保护进程连续训练的代数，共用模型与优化状态；每段计一次工具尝试，每段最多4096次候选评价。大研究建议显式配置。

cpu_threads.description: CPU数值线程数，不得超过宿主tool_threads；CPU秒按所有线程累计，与墙钟秒分别设置。

stagnation_patience.description: 规则调度的停滞代数阈值；0表示不因停滞提前结束，仍受授权代数、评价数和时间预算限制。

pause_at_checkpoints.description: 用户明确需要科研反馈时才按segment_rounds暂停；默认false，不是资源审批。

construction.meaning: tree-only legal construction, not a generator of general hypergraphs or spectral optimization

tensor_domain.parameters: exact rational alpha; positive-vector rational Collatz enclosure

capabilities.meaning: prepare remains a draft; execute evaluates supplied candidates; study searches only a reviewed finite scope. Formal metrics remain separate from training guidance.

meaning: prepare only drafts; execute evaluates supplied candidates; study searches within a reviewed finite scope with optional CPU CEM and bounded planning. None establishes a general theorem.
